caseLength.sourceNote: Converted from .866 in, Wikipedia infobox. No C.I.P. or SAAMI free dimensional standard was found for this discontinued round.

rimDiameter.sourceNote: Converted from .394 in, Wikipedia infobox. The rim is rebated — narrower than the case base — which is why the case functions in pistols built around the 9×19mm Parabellum's rim diameter.

maxPressure.sourceNote: Converted from a published 35,000 psi figure, Wikipedia infobox.

bulletMass.sourceNote: 170 gr bullet, from a handloading data page (Hodgdon), via the Wikipedia infobox. The published velocity on that page is a maximum-handload result tied to a specific powder charge, not a factory-ammunition figure, so it is not recorded.
180 gr bullet, from the same handloading data page, via the Wikipedia infobox. Velocity not recorded for the same reason.
210 gr bullet, from the same handloading data page, via the Wikipedia infobox. Velocity not recorded for the same reason.
